root_cause: The actions/checkout step for the 'LLM accuracy iGPU tests' job repeatedly failed to complete a shallow blob-filtered git fetch of the merge-queue ref (gh-readonly-queue/master/pr-37985-...) against github.com, with curl returning error 56 (connection died mid-transfer) three times in a row before actions/checkout gave up. This is a transient network/connectivity failure between the self-hosted iGPU runner and github.com, not caused by the PR's GPU kernel changes (resample_opt.cl / resample_kernel_*.cpp). The downstream 'ci/gha_overall_status_ubuntu_24' job then failed because it aggregates job statuses and one of its required jobs never ran.
reproduction_steps: N/A - transient network failure during checkout on a self-hosted runner; not reproducible via the PR's code changes. Retrying the same fetch command against the same commit typically succeeds.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed 'LLM accuracy iGPU tests' job (and consequently the overall-status job) - a plain retry is expected to clear a transient connection failure.
If curl 56 / 'Connection died' recurs frequently for this runner pool, check the self-hosted iGPU runner's network path/proxy stability to github.com.
No changes needed to the PR's resample_opt.cl / resample_kernel_base.cpp / resample_kernel_opt.cpp code.
prevention_strategies: Consider increasing actions/checkout's fetch retry count/backoff for self-hosted iGPU runners, or adding a network health-check step before checkout on that runner pool to fail fast with a clearer signal when connectivity to github.com is degraded.
historical_context: A related but distinct network checkout failure ('RPC failed; curl 16 Error in the HTTP2 framing layer') was recorded on 2026-07-07 (pattern a34cf8b1555a33e4, run 28868848906, PR #36754). This is the first recorded occurrence of the curl 56 'Connection died' variant.
